name: Paramount Communications Limited

annual_report.business: Paramount Communications Limited is amongst India's leading wire and cable manufacturers, delivering reliable, high-performance cable solutions across India and global markets for sectors including power transmission and distribution, railways, telecom, renewable energy, defence, space, data centers, construction, IT, and oil & gas.

capacity_or_capex.item: Greenfield manufacturing facility at Narmadapuram, Madhya Pradesh

key_risks: Severe disruptions in the United States (US) market
Higher churn, increased cost of operations may impact margins negatively
Decline in tariffs in a hyper competitive scenario
Impact of Labour Codes on employee benefit expenses

latest_guidance.statement: Five-year vision to reach INR 5,000 crores revenue by FY31
Narmadapuram partial commissioning planned for Q1 FY28
FY27 revenue growth guided at 15-20% YoY; operating margin target to reach FY25 levels by Q4 FY27 and ~8% by Q4 FY27
U.S. exports expected at 25-30% of FY27 revenue; Narmadapuram partial commissioning in Q1 FY28 with ~INR 500 cr revenue in FY28 scaling to ~INR 1,200 cr in FY29
5-year vision to reach INR 5,000 cr revenue by FY31 through Narmadapuram expansion, domestic penetration and export presence
